astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Simulation TNG50: A Galaxy Cluster Forms
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: How do clusters of galaxies form?  Since our universe moves too slowly to watch, faster-moving computer simulations are created to help find out.  One famous effort is TNG50 from IllustrisTNG, an upgrade of the famous Illustris Simulation.
